subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Even when buildings disappear, past activities can shape health, traffic, and development.”?
options: Before the class trip, Mr. Lee gave each student a small paper map.
Class 809 made a plain white lantern with many small windows cut into it.
A university built a digital model of a city to test traffic plans.
The class visited one former factory site being cleaned before housing was built.

本文沒有陳述「Class 809 made a plain white lantern with many small windows cut into it.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A university built a digital model of a city to test traffic plans.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Even when buildings disappear, past activities can shape health, traffic, and development. The class visited one former factory site being cleaned before…」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
